title: Vercel MCP Server
summary: Connect your agent to Vercel's official remote MCP server to inspect projects, deployments and build logs and search the Vercel docs.
description: Vercel hosts its own MCP server at mcp.vercel.com. An agent can search the docs, look at projects and deployments, read build and runtime logs and query Web Analytics.
Clients authorize through OAuth, so the config holds only the URL. The CLI command vercel mcp can set up several clients for you.
useWhen: Find out why the latest deployment failed
Read runtime errors for a production project
List recent deployments for a branch
Look up a Vercel setting in the docs

mcp.name: vercel
access: Projects, deployments and logs in the Vercel teams you authorize
Can manage projects and deployments through the tools it exposes

example.prompt: Why did the last deployment of my marketing site fail?
example.result: The build stopped at step 3: next build exited with code 1 because app/pricing/page.tsx imports a missing module, ./Plans. The previous deployment is still live.

faq.question: Does it need a token?
faq.answer: No. It uses OAuth; your client opens a Vercel sign-in page the first time.

faq.question: Can I limit it to one project?
faq.answer: Vercel's CLI command vercel mcp accepts a project option to scope a session to the linked project.

access: Reads deployment logs and analytics for authorized teams
Can change project settings and deployments
